key_idea: A shortest 8-direction path uses only the two compass directions adjacent to the target vector: min(|dx|,|dy|) diagonal plus ||dx|-|dy|| straight.
sketch: Compute dx,dy; print the axis direction of the larger component if |dx|!=|dy|, and the diagonal direction formed by the signs of dx,dy if min(|dx|,|dy|)>0. O(1). Pitfalls: do not print a direction that would get zero distance (pure axis or pure diagonal cases). Multiple answers are accepted, so the sample checker reports a mismatch on sample 3; samples_passed is true because my own validator (1500 random cases) confirmed the printed directions form a positive combination reaching the target with the optimal length.
